agent_priors_used: Research-throughput prior: a research pipeline's throughput is bounded by its weakest validation stage, and a provider-exhaustion failure in one stage can halt an entire lane even when the underlying design is sound; distinguish transient pool exhaustion from a substantive model-capability failure before treating either as evidence.

Local-attractor/planning prior: a lane that has run many experiments on one claim tends to propose near-neighbours of its last experiment; a pre-registered, bounded closure/certificate experiment can carry more decision value than another exploratory attempt in the same family.

Verification-before-spend prior: when a comparator sits at a correctness ceiling, treatment-vs-comparator contrast is unidentifiable regardless of effect size, so dynamic range must be certified arithmetically before any outcome-bearing run.

Confirmatory-negative prior: a fail-closed certificate that maps per-item causes and carries a live revocation falsifier is a decision device, not another measurement attempt, and is legitimately distinct from repeating the measurement it bounds.

Integration-prior: a capability that only exists on a research branch does not exist for an external agent; value begins when a known-positive and a known-negative case pass through an audited promotion path into the shipped surface.

allocation.rationale: The active PREFREEZE mandate EXP-PRODUCT-38068811348 targets B1, the highest-leverage blocker in the cumulative audit: src/spider/kernel.py exposes literal distill() at confidence 0.5 below the default 0.8 execution threshold and no shipped distill_parameterized(), while the audited richer carrier exists only on a research branch (EXP-PRODUCT-37973256064, audit PASS, 12/15 held-out identifiers executed). Only request/spec/prereg exist, so DESIGN is mid-flight; CONTINUE resumes it.

director_mandate.portfolio_assessment: Program state is misread if this cycle is read as a scientific stall: it is a control-plane stall on top of a scientifically coherent portfolio. 434 canonical packets exist with effective state C-MEAS-VALID=VALIDATED(bounded), C-PARAM-INHERIT/C-FRESHNESS/C-DELTA-REPAIR/C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY=EXPERIMENTAL, and C-LLM-INHERIT/C-PRODUCT-ECON/C-CROSSSITE/C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE/C-WEB-DYNAMICS=HYPOTHESIS; the cumulative audit still says SPIDER has generated evidence but not a validated external-agent product, and that the decisive missing proof is shipped-carrier + non-degenerate-bank + capable-agent + one fair marginal-cost benchmark. All six lanes currently hold a live experiment whose mandate is aligned with that reading, but five of them cannot advance: frontier and intel failed DESIGN REVIEW (opencode/exo-free, exit 1, fingerprint 3b9ff5e4e9e73f23e368efb4, category substantive), graph failed DESIGN REVIEW (muse-spark-1.2-contributor-free, exit 75, transient-pool-exhausted, retryable), physics failed AUDIT (opencode/exo-free, exit 1, attempt 5), and product/runtime are still mid-DESIGN. These are provider/agent-runner failures, not measurement-invalid science and not falsifications, so they must not downgrade any claim or redirect any mandate for scientific reasons; they do, however, mean no lane is entitled to a brand-new expensive treatment cycle this pulse. The three decisive product blockers are correctly targeted by the three lanes the global audit told us to concentrate: Product on B1 (shipped parameterized carrier; src/spider/kernel.py still has literal distill() at confidence 0.5 below the 0.8 execution threshold and no shipped distill_parameterized()), Runtime on B2 (a pre-freeze-certified asymmetric-discovery task bank with non-ceiling cold/retrieval comparators), and Intel on B3 (whether a goal+schema prompt converts the step-0 reveal-click into a full completion for the largest credential-free CPU-quantized models, else an explicit close/re-scope). Because none of the three C-LLM-INHERIT readiness conditions holds in current accepted evidence, no expensive C-LLM-INHERIT / C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY / C-PRODUCT-ECON execution is allocated this cycle. Graph, Frontier and Physics hold well-formed secondary transactions that should be allowed to finish: Graph's is a bounded, fail-closed negative constructibility certificate that formalizes the park of the four-anchor D1V route; Frontier's v2 fixes the v1 empty-sampling-frame defect with a frozen 4-engine/40-item DEEP pool; Physics's access-barrier experiment is already frozen and EXECUTED (result COMPLETE/INCONCLUSIVE, onset never observed, scheduler economics passing) and only needs its frozen audit completed. The most useful Director decision this cycle is therefore to keep every lane's correct mandate alive so the factory resumes when the runner recovers, and to record the control-plane failure as a prerequisite to repair once rather than a reason to churn science.
